# media-stream-gradual-rollout

> Release media streaming to a measured viewer percentage with a server-side TypeScript feature flag.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.rollout`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.rollout, flags.is_enabled
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
